QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: cameraDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Distance of the chase camera behind the vehicle.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Camera distance

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: cameraHeight
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Height of the chase camera above the vehicle.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Camera height

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: cameraAngle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Chase camera angle around the vehicle: 0 behind, 90 right, -90 left.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Camera angle

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: vehicleScale
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Vehicle model size multiplier; 1.0 is the model's real size (about a 1 m wingspan).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Vehicle scale

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: stlPath
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Custom STL model for the vehicle (millimetres, Mission Planner axes). Empty uses the model for the vehicle type.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Custom vehicle STL

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: adsbCircleSize
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Diameter of the ADS-B traffic circles.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: ADS-B circle size

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: cloudDensity
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: How much of the sky the clouds cover, from 0 (none) to 100.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Cloud density

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showTrail
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show the flight path trail while armed.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Flight path trail

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fpvMode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Look from the vehicle instead of chasing it.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: FPV mode (camera at aircraft)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: smoothMovement
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Carry the vehicle and traffic along between telemetry updates and filter their pose and the trail.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Smooth movement

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: hudOverlay
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Draw the Mission Planner HUD over the 3D map, without its sky and ground.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: HUD overlay

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: statsForNerds
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show the diagnostics panel: frame timing, terrain streaming, view and GPU.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Stats for nerds
